falsifier.registered_verbatim: "A candidate scoring form is REFUSED unless ALL FIVE clauses hold. (F1) MUST IMPROVE - the form must strictly raise at least one of: the number of samples whose first gold-bearing facet lies at rank 5 or better in the ranker's own candidate list, or the number of dispatched trajectories whose supplied task_target set contains the gold target. A form that is an EXACT IDENTITY on every measured quantity is NOT LICENSED FOR FLIGHT: it is refused as NO MEASURABLE GAIN, which is a different verdict from HARMFUL and must be reported as such. (F2) MUST NOT DEGRADE, MATCHING AXIS - the number of samples whose first gold-bearing facet is at rank 1 in the ranker's own candidate list must not fall, and the count of dispatched trajectories that LOSE gold-bearing supply must not exceed the count that GAIN it. This clause exists because the K1 gate's falsifier was ONE-SIDED and would have licensed a flight that loses: RRF-60 raised recall-at-5 while lowering recall-at-1, and under the measured, steeply rank-dependent conversion anchors 23 demotions against 9 promotions does not close. (F3) MUST NOT DEGRADE, EXTRACTION AXIS - supply is delivered ONLY to dispatched trajectories, and the measured extraction gain is conditioned on dispatch (unexposed-500 dispatched n = 163: macro slot-F1 +9.4391 pts CI90 [+4.3558, +14.5194], official SLU-F1 +13.7570 pts CI90 [+8.8840, +18.6695]). A form must not reduce the number of dispatched trajectories that receive a non-empty supply, and must not reduce the aggregate number of distinct supplied task_targets or the aggregate number of supplied values on the dispatched set. (F4) MUST NOT DEGRADE, DISPATCH RATE - the projected dispatch rate must not fall below 90 percent of the flown rate on ANY population (SLURP unexposed flown-v2 163/500 = 32.60 percent, locked-v1 reachable 160/500 = 32.00 percent; SLURP exposed 177/500 = 35.40 percent; A2T 15/104 = 14.42 percent). A form projecting a relative dispatch-rate fall greater than 10 percent is an OFF-SWITCH and is refused on that ground alone, exactly as E-C and K3 were refused - K3 projected 15/104 down to 3/104, a fall of 80 percent. (F5) MUST NOT MOVE THE LOCKED CELL BLINDLY - the number of the 500 UNEXPOSED SLURP decisions the form changes is reported explicitly for every form; any form changing one or more of them cannot be recommended for flight on offline evidence alone and requires its own registered flight, because a changed supply does not tell us what the frozen core would have answered."

alpha_veto_theorem.condition: alpha < 0.5 makes a RECOVERED direct label the strict, unique argmax of the blend for EVERY possible supply; alpha = 0.5 makes the worst case an exact tie, which _argmax_labels resolves as a multi-label best set and the controller therefore DISPATCHES; alpha > 0.5 lets a supply outvote the direct label.
alpha_veto_theorem.consequence: under the locked cell 'retain == direct-label-recovered' is a PROPERTY OF THE POLICY FORM, not an empirical finding: evidence can only ever reach trajectories from which no direct label was recovered. The reachable set is the label-free set, exactly.
alpha_veto_theorem.fused_range_argument: _fused_label_scores starts each label's raw score at best = 0.0 and only ever takes max(best, strength), so raw >= 0 for every label WHATEVER the ranker returns -- a negative or unbounded candidate score cannot make a raw label score negative.
